title: PRINCE OF PERSIA
subtitle: Jordan Mechner, 1989 — SDLPoP 1.23, the DOS game disassembled and rewritten in C by David Nagy

needsData.hint: data/ and SDLPoP.ini from the SDLPoP 1.23 source archive (github.com/NagyD/SDLPoP), side by side in this root

controls: step carefully, grab a ledge, strike
_why: The first program here that draws THROUGH SDL rather than beside it: paletted sprites keyed onto a 24-bit screen, 32-bit images blended by their alpha, surfaces converted between formats. src/env/sdl2-surface.js was written for it, with SDL_image's PNG loading (sdl2-image.js, png.js) and SDL 2's legacy audio device. Its music is the original AdLib data, played by an OPL3 emulator that is part of the program and compiled with it.
_fps: The page's cap. The game runs at its own twelve ticks a second and presents more often than that.
